description: An attempt at running GTA VI on PC
Work-in-progress fork of VIctory: getting an Xbox Series title to render and run on a Windows PC. No game files.
VIctory (Xbox Series compatibility layer) tuned for AMD RX 7900 XTX: faster preparing, texture read-back, findings. No game files.
DexNom RayTime is a source-only Windows compatibility layer for Xbox Series games. It translates graphics and ray tracing to Direct3D 12 and is tested on AMD Radeon with FSR 4.1.2.
Fork of DexNom/VIctory: measured frame-time optimisations for running GTA VI's Xbox Series executable on Windows (D3D12 layer). Fetch off the critical path, per-stage split, NVIDIA numbers.
VIctory fork for 8 GB+ NVIDIA cards: 7-8 fps on an RTX 5060 Ti (Series S profile + FSR), lower VRAM use, shader fixes. Shader help wanted. No game files.
GTA VI's Xbox Series build running on Windows PC (NVIDIA, 8 GB, laptops), built on victory-fork
Neptune HyperEngine by Dolberth (VIctory Fork) - Xbox Series PE loader & D3D12 compatibility layer tuned for NVIDIA 8GB GPUs, 16GB RAM, Ryzen CPUs & Windows 10/11 (no game files)
Xbox Series compatibility layer for Windows - runs console game code natively, reimplements the console system libraries and recompiles RDNA2 shaders to DXIL
VKarameloVI: runs an Xbox Series title natively on Windows on NVIDIA cards (VIctory-NVIDIA based). No game files included.
Xbox Series X|S (Scarlett) GDK compatibility layer for Windows focused on GPU/CPU sync performance, lighting stand-ins, and RDNA2 shader precompilation (derived from VIctory). No game files.
Fork of ztrx (Xbox Series title on Windows PCs) for older and low-memory cards on Windows 10: D3D12 Agility SDK loading, memory limits for small cards, movie and cut-scene skipping. GTX 1650 tested.
Research toward running owned Xbox Series titles on Windows: D3D12 diagnostics, texture paths, compatibility notes
VItoriaBr - Native Windows Xbox Series X|S runtime & D3D12/DXIL shader translator (PT-BR / EN)
An Xbox Series title on Windows, tuned for weaker PCs. Built on victory-fork and VIctory (credits in README). No game files.
Unified GTA VI Xbox Series compatibility fork (fxceless/victory-fork + Belobug ambient/quads + DexNom shader/PSO fixes) tuned for NVIDIA RTX 3070 8 GB

Frame-rate-first fork of ztrx (VIctory + fxceless) for running an Xbox Series title natively on Windows through an HLE layer. Measured per-command GPU profile, batching of the title's indirect stream, copy-back and texture-traffic fixes: 5.1 -> 8-10 fps on an RTX 3080 Ti, the card's own time 99 -> 29 ms. Every change behind a switch.

Runtime experimental em Rust para GTA VI no Windows, com perfil Series S para RTX 2080 8 GB. Loader x86-64, compatibilidade de APIs Xbox, tradução GFX10 para DXIL e DirectX 12. Configuração reproduzível, diagnóstico e checkpoint jogável validado localmente. Desempenho e renderização ainda em desenvolvimento.
Xbox Series X|S compatibility layer for Windows, tuned for NVIDIA GPUs (GPL-3.0, fork of VIctory)

Crimson: a performance-focused fork of Victory, the Xbox Series compatibility layer for Windows. Tuned for AMD RDNA2 GPUs with 8 GB (RX 6600 XT class), aiming for Series S–level performance. Based on Victory.
Original XCL compatibility fixes, validated community integrations, and experimental BCPack BC7 work based on ivall/xcl.
XCL fork for 8 GB cards: texture manager by use, lazy sparse tiles, memory ceiling, Series S plane compositor (GPL-2.0)
Run Xbox Series titles natively on PC
Coordination hub for running GTA VI (Xbox Series 1.0.2.1, RAGE 9) natively on Windows: package inventory, shader census convention, shared blockers, conformance corpus, licence matrix.
Acervo historico dos 12 projetos publicos que tentam rodar GTA VI no PC: 281 defeitos catalogados, correcoes rastreaveis por hash. Somente documentacao.
Xbox Series to Windows runtime lab: xcl patches, crash-time probes, verified first-run notes and falsified hypotheses.

Clean-room Xbox Series BCPack GPU decoder & 4K AAA benchmark (DX12 HLSL SM 6.6 + Vulkan 1.3 SPIR-V): 11.33 GB/s BC1, 6.02 GB/s BC7 rANS, Zero-Copy C-ABI, 1.25M Descriptor Paging, 12.41M Mesh Shaders + Hi-Z @ 150.6 FPS on RTX 5080 (19/19 PASS).
Decoder for Xbox Series BCPack (MDU rANS) textures. Rust library decodes BC1, BC3, BC4, BC5 and BC7; CLI exports BC1 to PNG/DDS; BC6H entropy solved. No game data.
a quick possible tester before recomp for giggles
Static recompilation research for Xbox Series X|S software on x64 Windows, with source-built CPU and GPU tests. Full-game startup is unverified.
Native PC port layer for an Xbox Series X|S title: the game's x64 code runs on your CPU and its RDNA2 GPU code is recompiled for your graphics card. Bring your own files.
GTA VI Xbox Series on Windows - fxceless fork + ported shader fixes (permlanex16, interpolation halves)
Open-source MIT C++20 Xbox Series X|S (Scarlett) translation layer for Windows 10/11 — D3D12, Vulkan 1.4, RDNA2 shader lifting, GDK shims, and real-binary telemetry
AnyXboxX — prototype d'émulateur Xbox Series X (HLE du GDK sur Unicorn)
Open-source native x64 interoperability, platform runtime and graphics research for Windows and Linux.
TuxBox is a new, native-first compatibility layer for running unpacked, decrypted Xbox Series X|S games on x86-64 Linux and Windows.
